title: Make the pre-commit PHP lint run on the local PHP 8.6 runtime
notes: 2026-11-27: git commit failed in lint:php: 'PHP CS Fixer currently supports PHP syntax only up to PHP 8.5, current PHP version: 8.6.0' (php-cs-fixer 3.95.2). Every commit fails until fixed; worked around once with PHP_CS_FIXER_IGNORE_ENV=1. Smallest fix: set PHP_CS_FIXER_IGNORE_ENV=1 in the composer lint:php script or run the fixer on PHP 8.2/8.5.
